summary: Trace radar faults from symptom to suspect, work Figure 8F12, install, maintain and service safely.

blocks.title: Symptom, then suspect
items: PPI, plan position indicator: paints each echo at its range and bearing.
Time is distance: just over 12 µs per nautical mile.

blocks.title: Receiver front end
items: TR cell (TR tube): shuts off the receiver during each pulse. Malfunction: receiver might be damaged.
Worn TR (TRL) cell: recovers slowly. The fixed blank distance looks smaller on longer ranges.
STC, sensitivity time control: front panel gain cut after each pulse. Too high blanks close-in video.
Silicon crystal: a diode in mixer and detector. Ohmmeter: low one way, high reversed.
Bad crystal mixer: replace crystal and TR tube.
Low or no mixer current: local oscillator misadjusted, mixer diode degraded or TR cell failed.
AFC, automatic frequency control: retunes the local oscillator as the magnetron drifts.

blocks.title: Magnetron
items: Heated cathode gives electrons; a magnet bends them past cavities ringing at microwaves.
Weak magnet: current (meter deflection) up, power down. High current: defective external magnetic field.
No field: quickly destroys itself from excessive current.
Lower duty cycle, weaker pulse: current falls.
Replace with a non-magnetic screwdriver.

items.name: Currents
items.means: Volts ÷ kilohms = milliamps. Add them, times R<sub>F</sub>, flip the sign. Card swap, −4.75 V: 0.1 mA too much, the 50 K became a 25 K.

blocks.title: Installing
items: S-band often uses coax: losses stay reasonable, installation cost lower.
Run waveguide as straight as possible, to reduce distortion. Avoid long horizontal runs: condensation.
Antenna site: first, not shadowed by other structures.
Radio interference: ground, bond, shield all units.

items.def: voltage standing wave ratio, highest voltage ÷ lowest; 1 is a perfect match.
high-Q cavity: artificial targets for testing and tuning.
performance drops, especially on weak targets.

blocks.title: More symptoms
head: Symptom
Suspect
rows: Check sweep, timing of both indicators
Distant targets gone during and after rain
Leak in waveguide or rotary joint
High VSWR, guide and joint fine

blocks.title: Safety
head: Job
Rule
rows: Proper work surfaces, ESD (electrostatic discharge) straps
Fails at once, or much later when critically needed
No explosives or flammable cargo being loaded
Discharge all high-voltage capacitors to ground
Gloves and goggles; dropped, it might implode

blocks.title: Exam traps
items: Video amplifier: brightness, never position.
AFC fault: flashing wedges, not spikes.
2 radars: never average readings.
Bad crystal: not the ATR tube or klystron.
